scope: Bounded exact-source next contracts only. Correlated same-team review is not independent validation; no native jobs, code, docs, shared registry, remote effects or new acceptance.

gates.subject: Combinatorics/DirectedGraph
gates.input: The actual finite PrefixInventory D of keyed occurrences at one fixed root, full TotalEdge equality, inventory prefix closure/Nodup/ValidFrom, and existing Packed ordered row references. Retain the root as an explicit external parameter.
gates.contract: Represent each inventory slot as an empty-root case or a checked parent-slot reference plus its actual final full typed edge. For nonempty d prove d=dropLast(d)++[lastEdge], parent∈D, all source/target joins, and parent rank=length(d)-1. Prove a decoder using strict trace-length descent expands each slot to its exact original full trace. Then existing dictionary unpack recovers keyed traces; the separate actual EdgeTrace decoder recovers the full ordered keyed occurrences.
required_obligations: Parent references are in bounds; empty case is exactly the empty trace at the retained root. Nonempty rows include exactly one such root slot; empty rows need no slot.
Termination uses a proved rank decrease or a separately proved topological reordering, never an assumed parent index smaller than child.
Preserve original row reference order, keys and multiplicity independently from prefix sharing. Actual decode/trace injectivity must prove occurrence identity, not just endpoint identity.
controls: Empty rows; singleton empty history; distinct Bool parallel edges; revisited loop histories; repeated keyed rows.
Prove actual child-before-parent example: trace rows[a,a] then[a] produce D=[[a,a],[],[a]], so parent index can exceed child index. Existing parallel_inventory_exact already places root at slot1.
Two distinct roots can have identical empty trace words; prove that dropping the root cannot recover the intended empty-history endpoint.
A later checked pointer representation must reject missing parents or cyclic/nondecreasing-rank links; prove actual fixture failures before any intended negative consumer.
gates.reuse_and_limits: Reuse PrefixInventory.prefix_closed/inventory_valid, exact IndexedDictionary unpack, and actual EdgeTrace decoding. Pinned Mathlib List dropLast/concat APIs must be matched before implementation. This contract is not byte/optimal compression, stable revision slots, runtime/JSON refinement, proof or permission authority.

gates.subject: Analysis/MellinTransform
gates.contract: For every a:ℝ and n:ℕ, prove ∃C>0,∀r>0,∀y∈[1/2,2], ||iteratedDeriv n(fun x=>P(r*x)) y||≤C*r^(-a), for the exact current normalized P. C may depend on(a,n), not r or y.
actual_suppliers: Use the exact complex principal-log extension of P, its nonzero-z all-real-power norm bound, positive-real-part analyticity, and the actual closed disk centered at y with radius1/4 staying away from zero.

Supply the disk norm bound and real/complex iterated-derivative restriction identity, then apply the existing pinned Mathlib Cauchy derivative estimate with its actual DiffContOnCl and sphere-bound premises. No assumed derivative/interchange wrapper counts as this proof.
gates.direct_consumer: Apply the bound to actual G(Z,j,y)=A(y)P(2^j*y/Z)/sqrt(y), with r=2^j/Z>0 for Z>0. Combine actual derivatives of the fixed compact factor A/sqrt with the product rule to prove the source uniform G-derivative and Schwartz seminorm estimates. A seminorm constant may additionally depend on k,n or the finite seminorm family, never Z or j. The source two-sided estimate takes min(r^A,r^(-A)) with its explicit finite family.
controls: Prove actual omitted-away-from-zero obstruction: n0,a1,y0 gives P(r*0)=P0≠0, so no one constant bounds it by C/r for all positive r. Positive control must prove this before a negative consumer weakens y∈[1/2,2].
Keep r>0 and the radius1/4 disk hypotheses. A fixed-scale Schwartz object supplies no uniform-in-scale constant.
Do not infer nonsmoothness at Z0 from the retained Z>0 smoothness premise; the new statement concerns uniform scale estimates.
gates.limits: All listed source theorems are NOT_RUN locally. No full ideal/Hecke/calibration/physical detector, contour continuation, RH supplier or arithmetic norm summability is paid by this analytic gate.
